about_the_game:
Guide the character to the Torii gate while avoiding disruptions by matching colors with the cursor!

When you match colors, the puzzle rises and characters will move upward toward the torii.

When you match colors while the puzzle is rising, it rises again in succession.

The more it rises, the more your excitement rises!

・Features

An action-puzzle game that blends color-matching with your cursor, obstacle avoidance.

Matching colors and consecutively raising puzzles is the key to success.

With three difficulty levels to choose from, players of all skill levels can enjoy the game—even those who aren’t comfortable with fast-paced controls.

・Stage Mode

Restore the chakra disturbed by the Demon King and guide everyone on the map to a safe torii.

There are also special gimmicks on the map that you can solve using the characters you’ve unlocked.

With a total of 30 stages, it should take about 1–2 hours to complete.

・Endless Mode

This is a mode where you compete to reach the highest score.

Rocks appear as obstacles and can be cleared by connecting four or more brown chakra panels to make them explode.

It will be unlocked when you get a ticket in Stage Mode.

・Time Attack Mode

This is a mode where you compete for the fastest clear time across all stages.

It will be unlocked when you clear Stage Mode.

・Versus Mode

This is a mode where you compete to reach the torii first while hindering your opponent.

In Stage Mode, unlocking characters with hindering skills allows you to use those characters!

■Important Notice

This game contains colorful flashing panel elements and frequently moving visual effects.

Individuals with photosensitive epilepsy or a history of seizures induced by visual stimuli should play with caution or avoid playing altogether.

■Finally

Your feedback is always welcome!
